summary.text: Bill Boyd is a Republican state representative from New Hampshire House District Hillsborough 12 who has served in the New Hampshire House of Representatives since 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He works as a real estate title examiner and previously served on the Merrimack Town Council.

paragraphs.text: Bill Boyd was born in Medford, Massachusetts, and lives in Merrimack, New Hampshire.

He graduated from Medford High School in 1987, earned a bachelor's degree in political science from Boston College in 1991, and completed the emerging legislative leaders program at the University of Virginia Darden School of Business in 2022.
His career experience includes working as a real estate title examiner and co-owning Midnight Run Racing Kennel.

Boyd was elected to the Merrimack Town Council, and during that time he served on the Nashua Regional Planning Commission and was appointed by Gov. Chris Sununu to the New Hampshire Drinking Water and Ground Water Advisory Commission.
Ballotpedia lists his House tenure as beginning in 2021, and he has represented Hillsborough 12 since the 2022 election.
He was assigned to the Public Works and Highways Committee for the 2023-2024 session.
